custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click List in the display switcher.
  2. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  3. Click {Work-order-1} to open it.
  4. Read Total Hours on the work order page.
  5. Click Work Orders in the top menu.
  6. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  7. Click Search, clear it and type the name of {Customer-A}.
  8. Click Fields to display and turn on Estimated hours.
  9. Close Fields to display.
  10. Read the estimated hours on {Work-order-1}'s card.
